markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (55%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Careful review
Invasive probability is 0%; Normal and Benign are not separable.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 55%, Benign 45% | Near coin-flip |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90%) | Cannot separate them |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.95 / 88th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes, both Normal | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Normal, 2/5 Benign | Leans Normal [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Score below typical; lowers invasive association [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; lower-invasive association [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; small effect · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; spot check only 12/20 [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to track classifier. Mitoses, necrosis unreliable; not used.

## Could be wrong if
- Image is a simulated, resample-degraded frozen section (severity 3); fine detail may be lost.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3:** older per-region probe gives 75% and 62% invasive; look for infiltrating tumor.
2. **Region 0:** highest pleomorphism score; confirm atypia. Necrosis score is unreliable.
3. **Region 8:** strongest duct-confined signal (Weak); check ducts for atypia separating Benign from Normal.
